title: Foundit Jobs Search
description: Type a job title and press Start: you get the newest matching jobs from all nine foundit sites (formerly Monster India, Monster Gulf and Monster Asia), 450,000+ open jobs. Type a place to search only the site that lists it. Every other field is optional. Press Start with the form empty for the newest jobs of every kind.

searchTerms.title: Job titles to find (searchTerms)
searchTerms.description: Type the job titles or keywords to find, one per line, for example python developer or data analyst. A job matches when its title has every word of a line: frontend also finds Front-End. Leave it empty to get the newest jobs of every kind. A pasted foundit search link (foundit.in/srp/results?query=...) works too.

location.title: Where the job is (location)
location.description: Type where the jobs should be, one per line: a city (Bangalore, Mumbai, Dubai, Manila), a state (Karnataka), a country (India, UAE, Singapore) or a region (Gulf, Southeast Asia). Each place is searched on the foundit site that lists it, so India and the Gulf fit in one run. Bangalore also finds Bengaluru. Remote alone asks for remote jobs; next to other places it narrows nothing. Leave it empty for all nine sites.

experienceYears.title: Experience (experienceYears)
experienceYears.description: Type the years of experience to match: a number such as 3, a range such as 2-5, 5+ for 5 or more, or fresher for 0. A job is kept when the experience it asks for overlaps yours, so 3 finds jobs for 2-5 and 3-8 years. Jobs that state no experience, over 40% of them, are left out once you set it. Leave it empty for any experience.

postedWithin.title: Posted in the last (postedWithin)
postedWithin.description: Pick how new the jobs must be: posted in the last 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or 30 days. Any time, the default, keeps every open job, newest first. The date is when foundit first listed the job, the date its job page gives Google, so an old job the employer renewed does not count as new. You can also type your own period, such as 48 hours or 2 weeks.

maxJobs.title: Number of jobs (maxJobs)
maxJobs.description: Type how many jobs to get, newest first: 100 by default. Type 0 to get every matching job; foundit shows up to 9,600 jobs per search and site. Each job is one charged row, so this sets the most a run can cost.

includeDetails.title: Full details (includeDetails)
includeDetails.description: Tick to add the full details of each job: the description as text and HTML, every place with its state and country, and the qualifications asked for. The run reads each saved job once more, about 2 jobs a second. A job with details costs $1.90 per 1,000 instead of $1.80.

workType.title: Remote or hybrid (workType)
workType.description: Pick remote or hybrid. Leave it empty for every job. Remote comes from foundit's work-from-home type and from Remote in the location or the title, hybrid from Hybrid in the title, so a job that says neither is left out once you pick one. foundit does not say which jobs are on site, so onsite is not offered. Typed words such as wfh work too.

employmentType.title: Job type (employmentType)
employmentType.description: Pick the job type: full-time, part-time or contract, or several. Leave it empty for every job type. These are the types foundit states; it has no internship type, so type intern in Job titles to find (searchTerms) instead. Typed words such as permanent or freelance work too.

excludeTerms.title: Leave out words (excludeTerms)
excludeTerms.description: Type words that leave a job out when its title has them, one per line, for example senior or manager. Leave it empty to keep every job.

searchDescriptions.title: Match descriptions (searchDescriptions)
searchDescriptions.description: Tick to match your keywords in the job's skills and description too, not only in the title: python then finds every job foundit's own search returns for python, whatever its title. Off, the default, a job's title must have every word.

jobUrls.title: Job links to check (jobUrls)
jobUrls.description: Paste foundit job links to check whether they are still open, one per line, instead of searching. Each link comes back open with the job, closed, or not found. Links of every foundit site work (foundit.in, founditgulf.com, foundit.sg and the rest), and so do old Monster links such as monsterindia.com.
